mines.mine_notes: Flagship project in Tanah Merah, Kelantan, Malaysia (~10 km, 2,370 acres). 81%-owned via CMNM Mining Group Sdn Bhd. Deposits: Manson's Lode, New Discovery, New Found, Sg. Ketubong, Rixen; first gold pour 21 Jul 2010. Open-pit and underground gold mining; CIL plant capacity raised 60% to 800 tpd with commercial production from May 2025; 2H2025 CIL gold output +65%. FY2025: 26,039 oz fine gold produced from CIL plant (+45% YoY), avg realized price US$3,589/oz (+46%). AISC US$1,357/oz (+5.9%), all-in costs US$1,459/oz (World Gold Council guidelines). Gold production/sales figures exclude gold produced from the flotation plant (base-metal concentrates: silver, lead, zinc). Two additional underground vertical shafts under construction at New Found (~358 m) and Manson's Lode (~335 m). Grade 1.7 g/t is the CIL resource grade; reserve grade 1.6 g/t. By-product (silver/lead/zinc) production quantities not disclosed (null).
100%-owned greenfield project via Kelgold Mining Sdn Bhd, ~30 km northwest of Sokor, Kelantan, Malaysia (~11 sq km). Exploration resumed in 2H2025; no reserves or production (null).
51%-owned via CNMC Pulai Mining Sdn Bhd, Kelantan, Malaysia. No mine-level production or reserve data disclosed in FY2025 materials (null).

notes: FY2025: revenue US$128.37M (+96.9% YoY), profit after tax US$52.20M (+327.1%), profit attributable to shareholders US$42.00M (+326.5%), EPS US 10.36 cents / SG 13.57 cents. Net cash US$62.56M, debt/equity 0.02. Dividends FY2025: interim 1.5 cents + final 0.8 cents + special 2.7 cents = 5.0 cents total (37% of earnings). Fine gold produced 26,039 oz (CIL only; flotation-plant gold excluded from production and sales figures). 1H2025: revenue US$52.8M (+77.9%), gold sales 11,811 oz (+26%) at US$3,197/oz. Reporting currency USD; dividends in SGD cents. Reserves/resources stated at 100% licence basis (gross); attributable-to-CNMC figures in reserves_resources notes (81%). All-in cost measures per World Gold Council guidelines.
